text:
incident-bot: ALERT: elevated 5xx error rate for service=model-runner-prod us-west-2 (rolling 5m error rate 12%). Pager triggered.

maya: paging oncall — seeing customer-facing timeouts and 503 spikes. Noticed spike ~09:12 UTC.

alex (on-call): on it. currently remote debugging. grabbing logs and cores.

alex (on-call): `ssh gpu-runner-12` — kernel logs show repeated OOM-kill for process pid=22411 and a segfault in model_runner. stack: `torch::native::alloc -> cuda::alloc -> runtime::alloc` then `SIGSEGV`.

leo: I see same in node exporter: memory used jumps then swap IO skyrockets. GPU mem saturates to 100% before crash.

alex (on-call): timeline: request spikes -> continuous-batching bump -> kv-cache growth -> oom on model_runner. suspect cache eviction bug plus some runaway attention kernel.

irene: quick mitigation: can we route traffic to lower-memory variant? `model-runner-v2-quant8` or smaller context?

alex (on-call): yes. starting emergency routing: set route policy `prefer=quant8 fallthrough=canary`. executing: `redwoodctl route set model-runner-prod --variant=model-runner-v2-quant8 --priority=high`

deploy-bot: ACTION: traffic migration initiated to model-runner-v2-quant8 (step 1/3).

alex (on-call): also enabling strict per-request kv-cache cap to prevent unbounded growth: `KV_CACHE_MAX_TOKENS=1024` on the serving nodes, pushing config via ssm.

maya: customer-ops, heads-up — which tenants show errors?

customer-ops: impacted tenants: greenchat, docssearch-pro, 3 trial orgs. Error type = 503 Gateway, some 500s with `segfault` in logs. Starting outreach to top 3.

sam: taking over live triage. alex, I'll coordinate rolling restarts and followups. alex you can hand off.

alex (on-call): handing off to sam. logs and notes in thread. key findings: OOM -> segfault in attention kernel; KV cache unbounded on long prefixes; quantized variant runs with stable memory footprint. core dumps saved to s3://incidents/3087654321/coredumps/

sam: acknowledge. starting 1) scale up temporary capacity (adding 4 gpus), 2) route 70% to quant8, 3) restart nodes with new KV cap.

leo: scaling now: `kops scalegroup --name=us-west-2-gpu-pool --replicas +4` — should be up in ~4m.

deploy-bot: NOTICE: canary hotfix build `model-runner@rev-2026-03-15-hotfix1` deployed to 10% canary.

sam: rolling restarts on problem nodes with `kill -9` replaced by `systemctl restart model-runner` to let supervisor collect crash info.

irene: adding a temporary circuit breaker at gateway: `max-concurrent-requests=256` and 30s backend timeout to reduce cascading retries.

metrics-bot: update: 5xx rate peaked at 12.4% at 09:13 UTC, after routing to quant8 at 09:18 UTC errors down to 2.1% at 09:23 UTC.

sam: patch note for the hotfix: add guard in attention kernel to bound tmp buffer allocations and fail fast with a graceful 429 instead of OOM. Also add periodic KV cache compaction.

leo: watching logs: core dumps show `free(): invalid pointer` in `kv_cache::compact()` in addition to the SIGSEGV in the attention kernel. Likely two bugs cooperating.

sam: immediate customer-facing mitigations: 1) route to quant8 (done), 2) add gateway circuit breaker (done), 3) scale up capacity (in progress), 4) enable canary hotfix (10% -> 50% if stable).

customer-ops: outreach sent to greenchat and docssearch-pro with ETA ~40m for mitigation progress. they reported degraded latency but are back to functional.

metrics-bot: realtime: avg latency increased from 180ms -> 420ms at peak; after mitigations latency back to ~220ms. 5xx dropped under 1% at 09:37 UTC.

deploy-bot: HOTFIX: `model-runner@rev-2026-03-15-hotfix1` promoted to 50% at 09:31 UTC. No regressions observed in canary logs.

sam: promoting to 100% rollout now, but will keep quant8 preference for another 2h to be safe. executing `redwoodctl rollout promote rev-2026-03-15-hotfix1 --to=100% --retain-variant-preferences=quant8`.

alex (on-call): followup items for postmortem: - root cause triage of `kv_cache::compact()` invalid free - audit attention kernel memory path for large batch/seq combos - add automated test for long prefix cache growth - improve OOM alerting to include `segfault` correlation

irene: I'll own customer impact summary & comms. sam please share final timeline and affected tenants.

sam: final status update: errors resolved, cluster stable, hotfix rolled. impact window ~09:12--09:37 UTC. affected tenants listed earlier, primary impact was elevated errors and latency.

maya: great work team. leaving notes and follow-up owners in the incident board. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT: resolved → monitoring. incident severity set to P1 -> downgraded to P2 after stabilization.

sam: leaving the room to oncall rotation. will open a full postmortem ticket with owners and timelines.

alex (on-call): saved all collected traces, heap profiles, core dumps to s3, pointer in postmortem.

metrics-bot: final metrics snapshot: peak 5xx 12.4% → 0.7% after full rollout. peak affected requests ~18k/min.

customer-ops: all affected tenants updated; follow-ups scheduled.

sam: closing thread, will link postmortem when ready. thanks everyone.
